title: An ACCRUAL of 0.33 interest + 10.00 fee + 15.00 penalty on loan 11 posts the interest pair, then the fee pair and the penalty pair as SIX separate legs (loan 11 L84)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry the accrual branch createJournalEntriesForAccruals [AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:2015-2087, dispatch :79-81, pinned commit 426a23544e8426a38ae43ae404670a0a7e85b9eb] posts for a tax-free an ACCRUAL transaction, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1_INTEREST_DECLINING_BALANCE_PERIOD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_ACTIVITY / loanProductId 31) at transaction L84. request.accrual_journal.transaction_id is "L84" and request.accrual_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's transaction id 84 (externalId 6abdc49e-764b-465c-97c7-23f783896f4e, type loanTransactionType.accrual, value Accrual): interestPortion 0.33, feeChargesPortion 10.0, penaltyChargesPortion 15.0, principal and overpayment 0. Zero portions are carried as "0"; there is no principal or overpayment field because the observed accrual posts neither. request.accrual_journal.accounts is the RESOLVED product slot->account mapping read from The slot->account mapping is the accepted create requests product-mappings/create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_ACCRUAL_ACTIVITY.json (sha256 666ace910cd27fc7cef6c8d3b523fd03c723cac37a1ae91d4f4fdb72fafeb402) and product-mappings/create-request-LP1_INTEREST_DECLINING_BALANCE_PERIOD_DAILY_ACCRUAL_ACTIVITY.json (sha256 a4fba0993ada42e0f11a05568951ae14da41de99fdff23fea919803755c153a6), which agree: receivableInterestAccountId 7, receivableFeeAccountId 7, receivablePenaltyAccountId 7, interestOnLoanAccountId 8, incomeFromFeeAccountId 5, incomeFromPenaltyAccountId 5. expect.accrual_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the L84 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 176 DEBIT 7 0.33, JE 177 CREDIT 8 0.33, JE 178 CREDIT 5 10.0, JE 179 DEBIT 7 10.0, JE 180 CREDIT 5 15.0, JE 181 DEBIT 7 15.0. Every swept leg carries reversed false and the sweep holds only these legs for L84, so no later reversal is mixed in. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: the interest pair posts DEBIT then CREDIT; the fee group and the penalty group are TWO separate charge-helper calls, each CREDIT then DEBIT, and they do NOT merge even though the fee and penalty credits both name account 5 and both debits account 7 (a port that merges them emits four legs, not six). WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the swap an ACCRUAL_ADJUSTMENT performs (this transaction is an accrual), a portion whose group is absent (all three are positive here), and the tax branch or any charge-specific GL mapping (no input exists for them). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
